notes: Calendar tidy-up: every change can now be undone. Before changing an event, HouseRunner notes its old title and colour in a hidden tab of your Google Sheet. After a tidy-up there’s an “Undo this tidy-up” button, and “Undo an earlier tidy-up” lists the last ones. An event you’ve changed again since is left alone.
Setup – Your family: the home address no longer disappears when you add or remove a person. Saving says it can take up to half a minute (it asks your council about bin days) and shows it’s busy.
Setup: a new copy of the Sheet starts the family, calendar and licence steps afresh, so leftovers from an earlier attempt no longer count as done.
Setup: the licence step shows a half-done ½ mark when you carry on with the free trial.
Calendar colour coding: Save shows it’s busy until it has finished. Clearer wording about people set to “In Family” or in a group.
Sheet SETUP window: no longer opens with a ring and “Close dialog” tooltip on its Close button.
Start HERE picture: a note at the top that the floating step window has the same steps – use whichever you prefer. New setup video.
